meta.name: internal-controls-and-audit
meta.description: Designs and tests controls over financial reporting — segregation of duties, approval limits, evidence, and preparing for audit. Use this to design controls for a process, prepare for an external audit, respond to an audit finding, set approval thresholds, or assess where a small team's segregation of duties is genuinely broken.

copy.tagline: 设计并测试内控,为外部审计做好准备
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责财务内控,需要在审计前设计或测试控制。
copy.tagline_en: Design and test internal controls to prepare for your financial audit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you lead financial reporting and need controls that stand up to audit.

howto.what: Claude 会围绕财务报告帮用户设计和测试内控,覆盖职责分离、审批限额、证据留存,并协助准备外部审计和整改审计发现。
howto.when: 当用户要求设计或测试财务控制(如职责分离、审批限额)、准备外部审计或回应审计发现时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计报销流程的职责分离和审批限额方案。
say.note: Claude 会给出职责分离与审批限额的具体设计。

say.text: 我们要准备外部审计,请检查控制环境有没有漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会对照五组件逐项评估风险。

say.text: 审计发现我们审批是走过场,该如何整改?
say.note: Claude 会建议修复根本原因,而非承诺更谨慎。

howto.what_en: Claude helps design and test controls over financial reporting—covering segregation of duties, approval limits, and evidence—and assists with external audit preparation and remediation of audit findings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to design or test financial controls (e.g., segregation of duties, approval limits), prepare for an external audit, or respond to an audit finding.

say_en.text: Design a separation-of-duties and approval-limit plan for expense reimbursement.
say_en.note: Claude will give a concrete design for separation and limits.

say_en.text: We are preparing for an external audit; check our control environment for gaps.
say_en.note: Claude will assess risks against the five components.

say_en.text: Audit says our approvals are just a formality. How should we remediate?
say_en.note: Claude will advise fixing root causes, not promising more care.
